record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. Phase detail already holds half of what Spec and Evidence would show, so separate screens would duplicate it. One screen per phase with tabs keeps one place to look and one back stack.

## Counter-argument

Separate screens can each be laid out for their one job and opened from anywhere without carrying the other tabs' loading cost.

payload.alternatives: separate Spec and Evidence screens beside an unchanged phase detail; separate screens with phase detail slimmed to an overview; opening the phase picker on All phases; a stacked document of every phase
payload.choice: Phase detail becomes one tabbed phase screen (Overview, Spec, Design, Decisions, Evidence, Tasks); p, s, and e open it at Overview, Spec, or Evidence for the selected phase, or the cursor row's phase on All phases

record.subject: phase-screen-tabs
